shared_elements: low-relief human figure in strict profile
bearded/detailed head in profile facing left
figure holding or grasping an object in raised hand
justification: Both are shallow relief panels with profile human figures rendered on a single ground plane, both include multi-petalled rosette motifs (a decorative band in A, blossoms on a stylized plant in B) and both show a figure with an arm raised holding something. The decisive difference is that A depicts a lead animal — a two-humped camel — in a procession with an attendant, whereas B depicts a large winged supernatural figure with kneeling posture beside a plant, with no animal and no processional register.
